# Tiger Shroff Survives Shocking Assassination Attempt in Mumbai as Three Suspects Are Arrested

**SEO Title:** Tiger Shroff Assassination Attempt: Three Suspects Arrested

**Meta Description:** Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff narrowly escaped a shooting in Mumbai on October 18, 2026. Three suspects have been arrested as police investigate the attack.

**Excerpt:** Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff has reportedly survived a shooting targeting his car in Mumbai’s Juhu area. Seven rounds were fired during the incident, leaving his driver and a bystander injured. Police have arrested three suspects as investigations into the motive continue.

## Tiger Shroff Targeted in Mumbai Shooting

Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff narrowly escaped a potentially deadly attack after gunmen opened fire at his car in Mumbai on Sunday evening, October 18, 2026.

The incident occurred in the Juhu area as the actor was leaving a birthday celebration near Pushpa Narsee Park, also known as Jamnabai Nursery. According to Indian media reports, three men arrived on a motorcycle and opened fire at the vehicle carrying the actor.

The shooting reportedly involved seven rounds fired at close range. The incident has raised fresh concerns about the safety of celebrities in India's entertainment industry, particularly following reports of threats and criminal groups targeting prominent personalities.

Although Shroff escaped serious injury, his driver and a nearby bystander were reportedly injured during the attack.

## How the Attack Happened

According to reports, the attackers approached Shroff's vehicle at approximately 7 p.m. as it was leaving the location.

Footage of the incident reportedly captured the moment shots were fired at the car. The attackers subsequently fled on a motorcycle.

Shroff escaped with minor injuries reportedly caused by shattered glass and gunpowder residue. He did not sustain a gunshot wound, according to police updates reported by Indian media.

His driver, identified in reports as Firdaus, sustained injuries, while a bystander who was nearby also suffered a bullet wound.

The incident could have had more serious consequences. Investigators reportedly recovered empty bullet casings and live ammunition from the scene, while early reports suggested that a firearm malfunction may have prevented further shots from being fired.

The shooting has since become a major talking point among Bollywood fans and social media users.

## Three Suspects Arrested After Police Investigation

Mumbai Police launched an investigation immediately after the shooting, deploying teams to identify the suspects and trace their movements.

On October 19, authorities reportedly arrested three suspects at Kota railway station in Rajasthan, less than a day after the incident.

Investigators traced the suspects' movements using technical evidence and information about the motorcycle allegedly used in the attack. Reports indicate that the motorcycle was abandoned in Mumbai before the suspects continued their journey by train.

Police also reportedly recovered the motorcycle, although the firearms used in the shooting had not been recovered in the initial reports.

The three suspects were taken into custody for further investigation. Authorities are examining their alleged roles in the attack, possible connections to other individuals and the reasons behind the shooting.

The arrests represent a significant development in the investigation, but police are still working to establish the full circumstances surrounding the incident.

## Lawrence Bishnoi Gang Connection Under Investigation

The shooting attracted further attention after individuals claiming links to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang reportedly claimed responsibility for the attack through social media and audio messages.

The gang has previously been associated with threats and attacks involving prominent figures in India. However, a claim of responsibility circulated online does not independently establish who ordered or carried out a particular crime.

Mumbai Police have reportedly been investigating the claims and examining whether the suspects had connections to handlers or other people who may have coordinated the incident.

As of the latest reports, the motive had not been conclusively established. Investigators are considering different possibilities, and it would be premature to treat any alleged gang connection as proven.

Authorities are expected to continue examining evidence and questioning the suspects to determine whether the shooting was intended to kill the actor, intimidate him or achieve another objective.

## Was Tiger Shroff Previously Threatened?

Another important question surrounding the incident is whether Shroff had received threats before the shooting.

According to police statements reported by Indian media, the actor had not previously filed a complaint about receiving threats.

Investigators are nevertheless examining whether the attack was planned in advance. Reports suggest that the suspects may have visited the location on an earlier occasion when Shroff was not present.

If established, this could help investigators determine whether the attackers deliberately tracked his movements before carrying out the shooting.

Police have not yet conclusively established the complete motive or identified all individuals who may have been involved.

## How the Attack Has Raised Concerns About Celebrity Security

The shooting has renewed concerns about the security of high-profile personalities in India's film industry.

Actors, musicians and other public figures frequently attend events, visit restaurants and interact with fans in public spaces. While these appearances help celebrities maintain connections with their audiences, they can also create security challenges.

An attack involving gunfire near a popular Mumbai neighbourhood highlights the importance of effective security arrangements, rapid police responses and investigations into threats against public figures.

The incident has also raised questions about how criminal groups allegedly recruit individuals to carry out attacks and whether the people directly involved are acting independently or following instructions from others.

For Bollywood personalities, the incident serves as a reminder that security concerns can extend beyond film sets and private residences to ordinary public appearances.

## What Happens Next?

With three suspects reportedly in custody, investigators are expected to focus on establishing the motive, identifying possible accomplices and determining whether anyone else coordinated the attack.

Police are also examining the evidence recovered from the scene and the alleged online claims of responsibility.

The investigation will need to establish the relationship, if any, between the arrested suspects and the individuals who claimed responsibility for the shooting.

Meanwhile, fans will be hoping for Shroff's continued recovery and for authorities to bring everyone responsible to justice.

## Conclusion

The shooting involving Tiger Shroff in Mumbai has shocked Bollywood fans and raised serious questions about celebrity security.

Seven rounds were reportedly fired at the actor's car in Juhu on October 18, 2026. Although Shroff escaped serious injury, his driver and a nearby bystander were reportedly hurt.

The arrest of three suspects in Rajasthan marks an important step in the investigation. However, the motive and any alleged connections to criminal groups remain matters for investigators to establish.

As the case develops, further police findings should provide a clearer picture of what happened, who organised the attack and why the actor was targeted.
